question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a brown present, and Claire has a green present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) brown present
(C) green present
solution:
Gift colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (purple, brown, green)
1. Bob and Alice swap: (brown, purple, green)
2. Alice and Claire swap: (green, purple, brown)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (brown, purple, green)
Bob has the purple present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
